objective: Create an authoritative Branch/PR Inventory & Disposition Register before any broader Core Intelligence or source-expansion work continues.
instructions: BRANCH HANDOFF: remain on codex/ku2d-core-intelligence-v1. Fetch/pull latest remote state and read coordination/queue.json from this branch before any work.

Do not perform broader Core Intelligence recommendation/ranking, new source exploration, live requests, ML training/inference/export, Survey/DoE/SEM work, production authorization, scheduling, or branch deletion in this checkpoint.
Inventory all remote codex/* branches currently present in thanitpu/KU-Open-Data-Analytics and all associated PRs where available.

For every branch, determine evidence-backed disposition using repository/PR state only. Allowed dispositions: ACTIVE, MERGED_HISTORICAL, PARKED_REVIEWED, PARKED_UNREVIEWED, SUPERSEDED, SAFE_TO_DELETE_CANDIDATE, NEEDS_REVIEW.
Do not delete branches. SAFE_TO_DELETE_CANDIDATE is advisory only and must include exact proof that unique reviewed knowledge/code is already merged or superseded.

Record at minimum: branch, purpose/theme, related PR number/state if any, base branch, head SHA, merged integration SHA if applicable, latest meaningful activity/evidence, disposition, whether unique code remains unmerged, whether knowledge has been projected into Learning Memory/Reviewed Learning Corpus/Core Knowledge, candidate evidence references if any, dependencies, recommended next action, and deletion-risk note.
Explicitly distinguish branches that were merged but intentionally retained as historical provenance from branches that contain unmerged work worth preserving.

For parked exploration branches, identify whether their evidence is already represented in Candidate Learning Evidence, Reviewed Learning Corpus, Core Knowledge, or not represented. Do not promote anything during this task.
Create a machine-readable registry, preferably services/data-acquisition/config/branch_pr_disposition_registry.json, with a versioned schema and deterministic validator/self-test.
Create a concise human-readable report under services/data-acquisition/docs explaining branch groups and recommended cleanup/review order.

Add a summary section that answers: total codex branches, active count, merged-historical count, parked-reviewed count, parked-unreviewed/needs-review count, superseded count, safe-to-delete candidates, and branches with unique unmerged knowledge.
Cross-check that no branch is classified from name alone; use PR/commit/repository evidence. Unknowns must remain NEEDS_REVIEW.

Preserve the current Core Intelligence Quality Foundation work in PR #46 unchanged except for files necessary for this inventory checkpoint and coordination records. If mixing the inventory into PR #46 would make review scope materially worse, stop and report that a separate branch/PR is preferable instead of forcing it into PR #46.
Run deterministic JSON validation, any new self-test, git diff --check, and relevant existing coordination/core-knowledge tests. No live acquisition.

Write KU2D-R-000011 with exact inventory counts, branch dispositions, PR mapping, knowledge-projection status, cleanup candidates, unresolved cases, files changed, tests/CI, and whether this should remain in PR #46 or move to a separate PR. Hand control back to assistant.
Do not merge or delete anything.
